sources.content:
AARAV MEHTA
ECE Student · Mysuru, India
aarav.mehta.ece@example.com · +91 90000 12345 · github.com/aaravmehta

OBJECTIVE
I like building small devices that measure something real and show it on a screen.

EDUCATION
B.Tech, Electronics and Communication Engineering — Kaveri Institute of Technology, Mysuru    2022 – 2026 (expected)
CGPA 7.9 / 10.

PROJECTS
Smart irrigation controller — final-year mini project                           github.com/aaravmehta/soil-sense
- An Arduino Uno reads two soil-moisture sensors and switches a 12V pump; readings go to a small web dashboard (HTML,
  CSS, JavaScript) over an ESP8266.
- Team of 3. I wrote the sensor firmware in C and built the dashboard.

ACTIVITIES
- Member, IEEE student branch (2023 – 2025).
- Took part in the college round of Smart India Hackathon 2025.

SKILLS
Hardware: Arduino, ESP8266, soil-moisture sensors, relay-driven pumps, breadboard prototyping
Languages: C, Python (basic), HTML, CSS, JavaScript
Tools: Arduino IDE, Git, VS Code
